old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-2nyu","title":"group_oscore: epoch semantics not wrap/grace coherent (validate_epoch, key_valid_at, id_context collision)","description":"python/src/lichen/crypto/group_oscore.py. Three coherent problems: (1) validate_epoch (:137-148) rejects every epoch \u003c current immediately, but spec 18.8.2 (spec/12-apps.md:1218) says old key_epoch is rejected only AFTER a 1-hour grace period — grace lives only in key_valid_at; two exported predicates encode contradictory acceptance policy. (2) Wrap unsafety: at current=0xFFFFFFFF the true successor (epoch 1, what rekey emits) is numerically \u003c current -\u003e rejected as rollback; key_valid_at tests material.epoch == self._current.epoch and key_for_epoch searches by number (:160,166), so after wrap the original epoch-1 material becomes unresolvable and the original epoch-max material reads future_epoch_unknown; test_wrap_boundary_validation (test_group_oscore.py:101-105) blesses the inconsistency instead of pinning the laggard side. (3) id_context = group_id||epoch collides across wrap (epoch 2 recurs): if key material were ever reused across the wrap boundary, nonce reuse gives full plaintext recovery. Fix: wrap-aware comparison via wrap-generation counting or distance metric; identity compare (material is self._current) in key_valid_at; drop/replace _previous entries whose epoch would collide on wrap; mix wrap generation into id_context or document never-reuse as an invariant; add the laggard-side test; reconcile validate_epoch with the grace window or explicitly document the split.","status":"open","priority":2,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"mark@reviewcommit.com","created_at":"2026-08-28T17:15:00.544086Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","updated_at":"2026-08-28T17:15:00.544086Z"}

new_value: Fixed in commit 1ee62b6a51: validate_epoch is now the documented accept-for-processing gate (wrap-aware signed distance on the cyclic epoch space; accepts current, +1 successor, and -1 predecessor while its material is held within the spec 18.8.2 grace window); key_valid_at is use-authorization scoped to held material by identity, not epoch-number equality; rekey drops retained entries whose epoch would collide with the wrapped epoch and enforces the never-reuse-across-wrap invariant via explicit RuntimeError (hmac.compare_digest), keeping the vector-pinned group_id||epoch id_context encoding unchanged. test_wrap_boundary_validation replaced by TestWrapCoherentSemantics (laggard-side accepts both directions, strict grace boundary, identity disambiguation, collision drop, reuse refusal). Vector verdicts in group_oscore_key.json unchanged (key_epoch_increment, epoch_rollback_reject current=5/message=3, epoch_future_reject current=5/message=7 all green). Tests: python/tests/crypto/test_group_oscore.py 19 passed; group_oscore_key.json consumer suites (test_group_oscore_epoch.py, test_group_oscore_wrap.py, test_security_app_vector_consumers.py) green, 159 total passed. ruff format + check clean.
